# CoreFoundation headers (headers only, no corebase code)

`stub/src/corefoundation/` (mini-CF) and `stub/src/coregraphics/CG.m` are written
against CoreFoundation's *types* — `CFTypeRef`, `CFStringRef`, `CFIndex`,
`CFAllocatorRef`, the `kCFType*Callbacks` structs, `CFRange`, …. The
implementations are all ours (mini-CF owns the plain `CF*` names since the
corebase-kill branch, docs/surface-audit/MINICF.md), but the declarations still
have to come from somewhere.

## Origin

GNUstep **libs-corebase**, pinned commit `b85d48066ba0fdb1333f94776cef122cdfba007e`
(the same pin `deps/Containerfile` used to build; upstream's last tag is from
2013, so a master commit was the only sane choice).

The files here were copied from the *installed* headers of that build,
`deps/sysroot/usr/GNUstep/Local/Library/Headers/CoreFoundation/`, not straight
from the git tree, because `CFBase.h` is generated by corebase's `configure`
from `Headers/CoreFoundation/CFBase.h.in`: it is where the fixed-width typedefs
(`UInt8` … `SInt64`, `CFTypeID`, `CFHashCode`) and `__LITTLE_ENDIAN__` get
resolved. What is committed here is therefore the **x86_64-linux-gnu**
configuration of those headers. Every other file is byte-identical to the
upstream tree at that commit.

## Contents

18 headers: the transitive `#include <CoreFoundation/…>` closure of the 11
headers macholo actually references —

    CFArray.h  CFBase.h  CFBundle.h  CFData.h  CFDate.h  CFDictionary.h
    CFNumber.h  CFPropertyList.h  CFString.h  CFURL.h  CFUUID.h

pulling in `CFAvailability.h`, `CFCharacterSet.h`, `CFError.h`, `CFLocale.h`,
`CFRunLoop.h`, `CFSocket.h`, `CFStream.h`. Nothing else from corebase is
vendored — no `.c`, no `CFRuntime.h`, no library.

## Refreshing

Re-copy from a corebase checkout at the pin, remembering that `CFBase.h` must
come from a `configure`d tree (or be produced from `CFBase.h.in` by hand for the
target triple).
